notes: theme.ts and system-theme.ts execute verbatim; theme-json.ts is copied for provenance only (its typebox dependency is not installable offline, so the validator seam stays re-stated in Rust per D3).
@earendil-works/pi-tui resolves to pi-tui.ts: re-exports of the pinned colors.ts/oklab.ts/terminal-colors.ts plus a getTerminalColorMode seam pinned via globalThis.__piColorMode.
chalk, config.ts, fs-watch.ts, syntax-highlight.ts, and text.ts are harness seams (chalk pins level-3 ANSI; config pins the themes dir to this directory; COLORFGBG is deleted from the harness env).

Each scenario group imports theme.ts with a distinct query string, so theme.ts module state (terminalColors/terminalColorScheme/terminalColorsPending and the theme store) starts fresh per group — the Rust replay resets its mutex-guarded state per test.
